verdict.rationale: API and CLI interface stability, versioning, and deprecation policy are fair questions for a package manager and build tool, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documented API versioning scheme or deprecation policy. The package-version coexistence and rollback features are adjacent capabilities about software packages, not about API stability. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and a version-numbered manual URL alone does not establish a deprecation policy.
